caption:
The top shelf, asked first

"Which shelf?" "The top one." The container went up where it lived, and not one wrong guess.

Asking where it goes takes three words, and the dish doesn't have to be moved twice.

For whoever asks where it goes instead of guessing.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen with two shelves on the right, one high and one low, and a plastic food container on the floor under them. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes asks which shelf. A brick-red block figure beside it answers the top one, and the container hops up past the low shelf and settles on the high one. The black one says ...top. got it. Both end with happy eyes. The text stays: me asking where it goes.
